cpu.reference: Speedometer 3.0, 2026-10-18: S20 FE Snapdragon 865 5.29 +/-0.40, published A15 3.66, desktop CPU4 3.74 +/-0.21. Main thread only; recalibrate on another host.

gpu.reference: Historical S20 FE game captures do not contain valid GPU timers. Never derive a desktop-to-A15 GPU multiplier from Speedometer or capped FPS.

network.reference: Synthetic shared 8 Mbps down / 2 Mbps up / 80 ms RTT condition; not a device specification. Applied to TCP, including compressed WebSocket bytes.

limitations: GPU timing and observed upload pacing are relative budgets, not hardware GPU or RAM emulation.
No per-tab control of physical RAM/VRAM bandwidth, cache, memory capacity or thermal throttling is claimed.
A diagnostic run with a missing domain must never report simulated A15 FPS.
